title: Morse Code Translator
h1: Morse Code Translator — Text and Dots
description: Translate text to International Morse and decode dots and dashes in the browser. Letters use spaces; words use slashes. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Convert letters, digits and common punctuation to International Morse, or paste dots and dashes to read them back. Encoding stays on this device.
blurb: Translate text to International Morse code and decode dots and dashes locally.
howItWorks: Type plain text or Morse made of dots (.) and dashes (-).
Choose a direction and press Translate. Unknown characters are marked with #.
Copy the result. Words in Morse are separated by a slash.
examples: A question mark maps to ..--.. and is restored when decoding.

faq.a: International Morse for A–Z, 0–9 and common punctuation. American railroad Morse is not included.
Separate letters with a space and words with a slash. Extra spaces are collapsed before decoding.
No. Translation runs in the page. Playback audio is not generated; this tool only converts text.
